Setup.Name: Convert radian in degree
Setup.Description: Converts a radian angle in degrees using the expression syntax.
Setup.Manifest:
Processors:
  - Name: "Sensor angle"
    Description: "Converts a radiant in degree using internal constant Pi."
    Mqtt: 
      Subscriptions:
        - Topic: "sensor/+/angle"
    Otel:
      Metrics:
        - Name: "Sensor.AngleInDegrees"          
          Instrument: Gauge
          Value: "PAYLOAD() * 180.0 / [PI]"
